title: HELIX Bridge: PeopleSoft CS → Disbursement

source_tables.description: Award disbursement records: one row per student, item type, term, and disbursement ID with scheduled, authorized, and disbursed amounts.
Fund name and federal fund code for the item type.
Student Financials item posted to the student account when aid disburses. Proves ledger posting.
COD origination and disbursement records with response status. FLAG: confirm delivered COD record names for your release.
Refunds generated from credit balances. FLAG: confirm local refund process tables.

notes: Disbursement is where Financial Aid meets Student Financials. Map the FA side from PS_STDNT_AWRD_DISB and confirm posting from PS_ITEM_SF. A disbursement that FA shows as paid but has no SF item is a reconciliation finding, not a mapping error.
privacy: RESTRICTED. This is a FERPA education record and GLBA-covered customer financial information. Land in bronze under the restricted KMS key, tokenize SAI, COD loan IDs, and PJ or appeal text at silver, and grant only to financial aid roles (govern/access-control-matrix.json, ACM-SPECIAL-002).
